title: Checkout: shipping address
content:
Checkout, step 2 of 3: Shipping address.

Progress: 1 Cart (done), 2 Shipping (current), 3 Payment.

Fields:
- Full name (required)
- Address line 1 (required), Address line 2 (optional)
- City (required), State or region (required), Postal code (required)
- Country (required): United States, Canada, Mexico
- Phone (required, for the courier)
- A checkbox: "Billing address is the same"
- Shipping speed (choose one): Standard, 5–7 days, free; Express, 2 days, $12

Buttons: Continue to payment; Back to cart (link to /cart).
Order summary beside the form: Ridgeline 40 L × 1, $189; Shipping $0; Total $189.
